component.name: Vibemapp
component.summary: See your ZSA keyboard layout and switch layers per app

description.p: Vibemapp is a companion app for ZSA keyboards running Oryx firmware, such as the Voyager, Moonlander and ErgoDox EZ.

ul.li: Smart Layers: switch the keyboard to a layer automatically when you focus an app
Optional window title patterns for finer-grained rules
See every layer of your Oryx layout, following the keyboard live
Watch key presses as you type, with tooltips for every key
Optional key heatmap: see which keys you use most, per layer and period. Only per-key press counts are stored, never what you type
Runs quietly in the tray or in the background

description.p: Smart Layers currently requires the Hyprland compositor.
KeyMapp for Linux is now called Vibemapp. Your settings and Smart Layers rules are carried over automatically.

ul.li: New Heatmap page: opt-in per-key press counts for today, the last 7 days or all time, per layer, with your most used keys
Tray icon: closing the window keeps Vibemapp in the tray, with quick access to Smart Layers and the current layer
Key tooltips now follow the pointer from key to key

description.p: First release, with Smart Layers for Hyprland and a live layout viewer.
